Vaelis Emberglass — level 1

The old elemental scholar with dangerous curiosity.

Elf Arcanist · HP 17/17 · Grit 2/2 · Speed 7 squares · Bulk 7/7.

Languages: Common, Elven and Dwarven (Another Tongue). See the @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b65e9644d24629f2.JournalEntryPage.0237eee3512bbfa9]{language reference}.

Attributes and ancestry

BrawnFortitudeAgilityGuileKnowledgeReason
-1+0+1+0+2+1

Total +3. Arcanist minima: Agility, Knowledge ≥ 0; met. Mental sum +3, so each stage’s base pool is 13 DP.

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.13cb3a0fb9fb2e9e.JournalEntryPage.15d5be6aa14c44b9]{A Lifetime Ago}: Choose one place or community you knew in an earlier age. Gain 1 Boon to Knowledge or Reason rolls recalling its history, people or construction. The DA can tell you what you genuinely witnessed without a roll; memory reveals no events you never knew. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.262ef689d8185dd3.JournalEntryPage.112aaae66756a291]{Dream beneath the Stars}: You may rest in a quiet waking reverie instead of sleeping, remaining aware of nearby ordinary sights and sounds. It grants no automatic detection, extra downtime work, shorter treatment interval or Grit recovery. Magical Asleep still works normally.

A Lifetime Ago: the community of Emberglass Observatory, where Vaelis studied before its abandonment. This is fictional history, not an extra culture grant.

Level 1 — class and purchases

Choose @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.89ce8e1d2af8a0be.JournalEntryPage.0f7b9607ec6639ab]{Arcanist}. Class grants Scholarship 1 and Calling 1; 0 duplicate(s) give +0 DP, not higher ranks. Free signature: @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.d05ae00389833159.JournalEntryPage.21fcaf9e7fd6e445]{Deliberate Spark}. Its use procedure follows; the linked card remains the complete reference:

Action: Passive · Attribute: None — no roll

Target / range / shape: One creature hit by your Main Action damaging spell.

On a Standard or Strong result, after resolving the spell, you may push one of its targets 1 square directly away from you. Use this once on your turn. It adds no direct damage; normal collision rules apply.

Duration: Immediate push after the spell.

Equipment / acquisition: None.

Signature limit: Once on your turn; no benefit from free attacks.

Fresh pool: 13 + 0 = 13 DP. All discipline purchases below occur before cards that need them.

Final disciplines: Calling 1, Flame 1, Frost 1, Scholarship 1, Storm 1.

Equipment and derived statistics

No mechanical equipment is granted by these ability choices. Market purchases are listed below. Ordinary appearance/clothing is descriptive; no armor, weapon, focus, tools or adventuring supplies are assumed.

HP: 12 + ancestry 2 + class 2 + Fortitude 0 + trait 0 + Conditioned Body 1 = 17. Capacity: 10 + 3 × Brawn (-1) = 7. Granted Bulk 0 + purchased Bulk 7 = 7, so encumbrance penalty 0. Speed: ancestry 6 + Agility 1 + trait 0 = 7.

Physical resistance: 0. Other resistances: 0. Wounds and death marks: 0. Grit: 2. No HP or Grit has been spent during creation.

Starting coins and market purchases are resolved in the shopping ledger below. Card-granted equipment is not purchased again. Repeated compatible weapon/tool grants supply no duplicates.

Recipes: none granted or purchased.

At the table

Cinder Cast and Rime Grip provide distinct elemental choices; Gust Hammer adds another positioning tool. Deliberate Spark adds its printed shove to a qualifying Standard or Strong Main spell once on Vaelis’s turn. Reading remains, identifying enchantments and speaking with a hearth establish the scholar outside battle. No staff, spellbook or focus is required or granted by these cards; both hands begin available.

Complete learned-card checklist

These are all origin grants, purchases and the free signature; there is no equipped-card limit. Universal references are supplied separately.

All 18 universal cards are available without DP: Basic Melee, Basic Ranged, Basic Throw, Basic Unarmed, Force, Aid, Defend, Disengage, Stabilize, Shield Block, Opportunity Attack, Move, Stand, Handle an Item, Use a Healing Potion, Reduce a Condition, Command a Summon and Convert an Action. Their equipment and situation requirements still apply.

Summoning revision: the former tiny-scout card is now Summon Fey — Novice. Its Calling 1 requirement and 2-DP cost are unchanged, so this ledger stays valid; choose an eligible creature from the summon profiles. No tiny form, scouting sense or object-carrying ability is automatically supplied.
